dict.string: Augment uses Accessibility to read window positions, draw live previews on Dock hover, and intercept Dock clicks for the focus-aware minimize behavior.

Augment reads each app’s audio stream so the Volume Mixer can set a separate volume per app. Nothing is recorded or saved.
